name: Buffalo Chicken and Blue Cheese Casserole
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F, or set a slow cooker to LOW.
Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Toss it with the butter and pepper. No sauce.
Bake 25–30 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F. In a slow cooker, cook on LOW about 3 hours, then shred.
Stir in the blue cheese until it melts. Rest 5 minutes.
Divide into 4 boxes. One box is one dinner.
doneWhen: Chicken is 165°F and the blue cheese is melted.
tips: Carnivore version of the buffalo casserole. Hot sauce and cream cheese are out: hot sauce is peppers and most of the salt, and cream cheese was a second dairy. The blue cheese stays, about 3/4 oz in each box. Unsalted butter. Fridge 4 days. Log one box, not the pan.

name: Butter Chicken
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F, or set a slow cooker to LOW.
Cut the chicken into pieces. Toss it with the butter and pepper.
Bake until 165°F, about 25–30 minutes. On LOW, about 3 hours, then shred.
Divide into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: Chicken is 165°F and coated in butter, with no cheese and no sauce.
tips: The strict carnivore plate: meat and butter only. Use this when you want the casserole without cheese. Fridge 4 days.

name: Buffalo Chicken and Blue Cheese
time: About 10 minutes if the chicken is already cooked
instructions: Warm the chicken in the butter.
Put the blue cheese on top and let it soften.
Eat the chicken first.
doneWhen: Chicken is hot and the cheese has softened.
tips: The one-plate version. No hot sauce and no ranch. Half an ounce of blue cheese.

name: Chicken and Eggs
instructions: Warm the chicken in the butter.
Cook the eggs in the same pan, peppered.
Eat the chicken and eggs. Nothing else on the plate.
doneWhen: Chicken is hot and the eggs are set.
tips: Carnivore breakfast. No toast and no fruit.

name: Steak and Eggs
instructions: Season the sirloin with pepper. Sear it in a hot pan, about 2 minutes a side for medium.
Rest it. Cook the eggs in the butter.
Eat the steak first, then the eggs.
doneWhen: Steak is browned and the eggs are set.
tips: Carnivore. Sirloin keeps this in a weight-loss portion. A ribeye is the same plate with more fat and more calories.

name: Eggs and Cheddar
instructions: Melt the butter. Scramble the eggs with pepper until just set.
Turn off the heat and fold in the cheddar.
doneWhen: Eggs are set and the cheddar is melted.
tips: Carnivore. Four eggs and half an ounce of cheddar. The cheese is the salt, so it stays a small piece.

name: Beef and Egg Skillet
instructions: Brown the beef with pepper. Drain the fat.
Add the butter and the eggs. Scramble until the eggs are set.
Divide into 4 boxes.
doneWhen: No pink beef, eggs set, not dry.
tips: Carnivore batch breakfast. Fridge 3 days. Lean beef keeps the calories down.

name: Cheeseburger, No Bun
instructions: Form one patty and pepper it.
Cook it in a hot pan to 160°F.
Melt the cheddar on the patty with the butter. Eat it with a fork. No bun.
doneWhen: Patty is 160°F and the cheese is melted.
tips: Carnivore. No bun. Half an ounce of cheddar keeps the salt down.

name: Butter Beef Patties
instructions: Form 4 patties and pepper them.
Cook to 160°F.
Brush each patty with the butter. Box them.
doneWhen: Each patty is 160°F in the center.
tips: Carnivore. No sauce. Fridge 3 days. A fattier blend adds calories fast, so stay with 93% if you are logging a deficit.

name: Salmon with Butter
instructions: Pepper the salmon.
Cook it in 1 tsp butter until it flakes, about 125–145°F.
Put the rest of the butter on the fish.
doneWhen: Salmon flakes and the butter is melted on it.
tips: Carnivore. No lemon and no dill if you are being strict. Fridge 2 days.

name: Butter Salmon
instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F or a pan over medium.
Pepper the salmon and dot it with butter.
Cook until it flakes, about 12 minutes in the oven.
Cut into 4 portions.
doneWhen: The center flakes and is opaque.
tips: Carnivore batch. Fridge 2 days. Do not freeze it if you want it to stay moist.

name: Pork with Butter
instructions: Pepper the tenderloin.
Sear it, then lower the heat and cook to 145°F.
Rest 3 minutes. Finish with the butter.
tips: Carnivore. Tenderloin, not bacon. Bacon is the salty version of this plate.

name: Pork Chops and Butter
instructions: Pepper the chops.
Cook to 145°F. Rest 3 minutes.
Brush with butter and box into 4.
doneWhen: Each chop is 145°F after the rest.

name: Chicken and Blue Cheese
instructions: Eat the chicken.
Eat the blue cheese with the last bites.
doneWhen: Cold chicken, cheese still in a small piece.
tips: Carnivore snack. Half an ounce of cheese, not a wedge.

name: Beef and Cheddar
instructions: Slice the beef.
Eat it with the cheddar.
doneWhen: Thin slices, small piece of cheese.
tips: Carnivore. Not jerky, which is salted and easy to overeat.

name: Egg and Cheddar
time: About 2 minutes if the egg is cooked.
instructions: Peel the egg.
Eat it with the cheddar.
doneWhen: Egg peeled, cheese a half-ounce piece.
tips: Carnivore. A small snack when the day is short, not a meal.
